household.members { person entitypush Determine_Adult_Status entitypop } forall

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate total income for an individual from all sources

false person /is_adult exch def true person /is_child exch def

action_details.action_postfix: "Minor treated as adult due to parental status" person.notes addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Create an Eligibility Determination Group (EDG) for each person who can be head of household. Each EDG represents a different way to evaluate means-tested program eligibility.

action_details.action_comment: Create EDG for each head; For each person who can be head, create an EDG
action_details.action_postfix: household.members { person entitypush person.can_be_head { Build_EDG_For_Head } if entitypop } forall

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Build a single EDG with the current person as head. Determines group members based on relationships and calculates group income and FPL.

action_details.action_dsl: Set the head of this EDG
Create unique group ID using head person ID
Create empty members array and add head
action_details.action_postfix: newarray eligibility_group /members exch def person eligibility_group.members addto

Calculate group FPL; Calculate FPL percentage for this EDG

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine which household members belong in this EDG. Includes: the head, their spouse, their children, and siblings under 18 who share a parent with the head.

action_details.action_postfix: household.members { dup eligibility_group.head ne { dup entitypush Check_EDG_Membership entitypop } { pop } ifelse } forall

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Check if the current person should be included in the current EDG. Rules: spouse of head, child of head, parent of head if head is child, or minor sibling.

condition_details.condition_dsl: Person is the spouse of the EDG head
condition_details.condition_postfix: person.relationship_to_head "SPOUSE" streq eligibility_group.head entitypush person.relationship_to_head entitypop "SPOUSE" streq and

condition_details.condition_postfix: eligibility_group.head entitypush person.is_mother person.is_father or entitypop

condition_details.condition_postfix: person.is_mother person.is_father or eligibility_group.head entitypush person.is_child entitypop and

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate the total income and size for an EDG

action_details.action_comment: Sum income; Calculate total group income from adult members only
action_details.action_postfix: 0 eligibility_group.members { dup entitypush dup is_adult { total_income + } { pop } ifelse entitypop } forall eligibility_group /group_income exch def

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Federal Poverty Level percentage for an EDG based on group size and income

action_details.action_comment: FPL for 1; Calculate FPL percentage for 1 person
FPL for 2; Calculate FPL percentage for 2 people
FPL for 3; Calculate FPL percentage for 3 people
FPL for 4; Calculate FPL percentage for 4 people
FPL for 5+; Calculate FPL for 5+ people
action_details.action_postfix: constants.fpl_base_4 eligibility_group.group_size 4 - constants.fpl_per_additional * + eligibility_group.group_income 100 * exch / eligibility_group /group_fpl exch def
